description: CyberLeak is a passionate team of Computer Science students participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We aim to transform innovative ideas into impactful solutions using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Python, Web Development and Data Science. We are enthusiastic about space exploration, scientific discovery and solving real-world challenges through technology. We welcome creative thinkers, developers and problem solvers to join us on this exciting journey!
summary: Our website GlobeLens provides a way to look into changes within the environment. They can search up a factor they wish to look at, a location and when they want to look at how the data has changed. Using graphs, maps and statistics we have provided a way to easily visualise how temperature, rainfall and more have changed. This was created as environmental data can often be messy and difficult for people to understand. GlobeLens can be used by students, researchers, environmental analysts and the general public. We want to help give people knowledge on how the earth is changing and why it is important to monitor.
details:
GlobeLens is a web application that allows users to look into how the environment has changed in different parts of the world. We wanted to create this as environmental data whilst easy to find can be very difficult to understand. Most data is stored in large data sets or technical reports and so someone wanting to know how the rainfall in their city has changed over the years would struggle to find the answer. We wanted to solve this issue.

Users can easily navigate the website by selecting what environmental factor they want to look at (temperature, rainfall etc.), then select a location and time frame. The data will then be retrieved and displayed using:

Graphs: showing how the value has changed over time. Increasing, decreasing or staying the same. Maps: allowing users to select where they want to look at. Statistics: allowing users to get a quick overview of the data. Showing averages, maximum/minimum values and overall change during the time frame selected.

GlobeLens has been designed to be used by 4 different types of users. Students can use it to view real data rather than just reading about it in textbooks. Researchers can use it to get an initial overview of trends within a region. Environmental analysts can use it to monitor changes across different locations and time frames. And finally the general public can use it to satisfy their curiosity and learn more about what is going on around them. We wanted this to be simple for new users but still provide useful information.

For the frontend we used React, Vite, JavaScript and TailwindCSS. React allowed us to create reusable components, Vite allowed for quick builds and TailwindCSS allowed us to create a clean and responsive layout. For the backend we used Python and FastAPI. This will receive the request from the frontend, process the data and return the results. FastAPI was chosen as it is quick and easy to use when creating an API. Python is great for working with data and calculations.

We also used a few libraries. Chart.js for the graphs, Leaflet for the interactive maps and Axios for communication between the frontend and backend.

We had some issues whilst creating this project. Firstly making sure the scientific data was easy to understand. As environmental data can sometimes be quite large and confusing we made sure our layout was clean and the most important information was shown. Secondly making sure the frontend and backend were linked correctly so the correct data was shown when changing the factors, locations and time frames. We tested each section to ensure they are all reacting correctly.

We feel this project is important as raising awareness is the first step to taking action. By being able to see how temperature and rainfall have changed in their region makes this a real and personal topic for them. Helping them understand how important it is to monitor the environment.

Going forward we would like to add more environmental factors, the ability to compare 2 locations, download data and more in depth statistical tools for more advanced users.

Overall GlobeLens is our attempt to simplify environmental data. By providing graphs, maps and statistics we hope to help users look into how the earth is changing and raise awareness of our world.
